description: Least-privilege capability set for the portable ArcScan main window. Identical to the installed set with the updater and the restart permission removed: a portable build does not link the updater plugin at all, so there is no install-and-relaunch path for the webview to be granted access to. External URLs, launchers, the data-folder reveal and file writes go through dedicated Rust commands that validate their input or take no input, so no shell, filesystem or opener permission is granted to the webview.
